**Figuring out food clues**

I’m piecing together a food that fits the clues. There’s something about the number eight, and I wonder if "popcorn" works since it has eight letters. The yellow, thin kernels and the fact that they pop with fire and air match well. Plus, they expand into big, white puffs when cooked. Other options like "pancakes" and "omelette" come to mind, but they don’t quite hit all the clues. Popcorn seems to be the best guess!
